where: Pale Vault interiors — the inn, a home, the Frost Lumenary hall
mood: Snow-Hushed Town — a small warm song against the cold: people and lanterns indoors, melancholy and intimate, hope that is fragile.
core_styles: 16-bit console RPG soundtrack from the mid-1990s
retro sampled-chip instruments with the warm echo of a 16-bit sound chip
gentle A minor warming toward C major
tender soft pulse-wave lead melody, faint and hummable
soft music-box arpeggio, slow and rounded
slow steady synth bass half notes like a quiet heartbeat
a single muffled soft drum pulse on the downbeat
a distant faint aurora swell once per phrase
snowbound village interior, lanterns in the dark, fireside warmth framed by cold

sections.name: Intro
sections.text: {a hushed warm entrance: a music-box figure turns over twice above a soft pad, like stamping snow off at a lit doorway, settling onto A minor}

sections.name: Main Theme
sections.text: {the tender melody, sung softly and nearly complete: a hopeful rising leap from E up to A and B, then a stepwise settle C-B-A; small, warm and fragile, front and centre}

sections.name: Main Theme Reprise
sections.text: {the melody again, a soft celesta counter-line glinting between phrases and the string pad warmer underneath, the cadence brushing C major}

sections.name: Bridge
sections.text: {contrast: the warmth breaks through into C major and F major, a gentle lifting line like hands held to a hearth, then a faint aurora swell leads back toward E}

sections.name: Main Theme Return
sections.text: {the tender theme returns in A minor; the last bar lands on the E chord leaning straight back into the theme}
